notes.content:
Hey there-

If you followed my announcements over the past year, the full remake is now finished, and I've added the machine translations for all the languages which were present in the legacy version.

To access the older version of the game, please use the Legacy build, as the newer remake is now the default.

notes.title: Beta 1.999 Available Today
notes.content:
Hey there-

A full year after I announced the remake, we've finally gotten to the finish line - at least for the English language version. Without further ado, here's what's in store:

[list]
[*] Five good endings - one each with Daisy, Lily, and Rose, a harem ending, and the new Man About Town Ending
[*] 146,000 words of story - almost 13,000 more than the previous 1.99 update.
[*] 743 animations in total; that's more than 200 over the 1.99 update.
[*] 5,394 images - considering the original game had only 3,600 images, it's a nice jump.
[*] 4 new music files in this edition, 1 new sound effect, bringing the total number of audio files to 463
[*] 40 scenes in the replay gallery - this is actually more unique scenes than the previous game, the gallery now for many scenes has a single replay and the in the scene you can choose the options for what parts to experience
[*] About 8 or so images updated with various bugs from earlier in the game (Lily when she first arrives at the house had some flaws in her shirt, as well as Elizabeth the first time MC sees her in the office).
[*] A brand new game ending for each of the five endings, not found in the previous edition of the game nor the previous 1.99 version - I'm happy with how this turned out, and I hope you enjoy it as well.
[*] New game icons included swapping the gorilla head with an icon of Daisy to better reflect the game content.
[/list]

I'll be back sooner than later with the machine translations to match the existing production version and any bug fixes or improvements by request.

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Beta 1.99 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey here we go! 

This version is not - yet - the culmination of all the hard work over the past year, but it's close, with this release including most of 2 of the 5 game endings, and a small chunk of a 3rd game ending. In total, this update has more content than any other during the beta process, since a lot of the scenes were updates & improvements to scenes from the prior version of the game, albeit with some fantastic enhancements.

[b]So what's in this 1.99 edition then?[/b]

[list]
[*] 19,000 words of story
[*] Hundreds of new images in multiple scenes and game endings.
[*] Two new endings "Finished," Man About Town (new) and the Harem (from the old edition of the game)
[*] Dozens of new animations including the remade scene with MC & Lois in the Man About Town ending (19 animations), the scene with MC, Elizabeth, and Tricia has all new animation (23 animations), the scene with MC, Sara, and Vanessa has some new animation as well (8 new animations), and of course, there's all the other animation that was improved to color match the visual style of the remake.
[*] Ten new sound effects + music files.
[*] Fixes to the early game overs to ensure you can resume playing as if you'd made one of the better choices in the game to ensure you don't have to restart from the beginning.
[*] Rewritten scenes from the older game to update the script, decrease the excessive repetition, and hopefully make everything better.
[*] What's not included yet: The solo Dee & MC ending, the solo Rose & MC ending, at least one scene from the MC + Lily ending, and some story scene(s) that will be added to the game that are brand new & were never included in the older edition of the game. After those are all done, I'll be doing the machine translations into all the languages as well.
[/list]

Next month, we'll have the other endings finished up, as well as any bug fixing, updates, or improvements needed from this massive update. 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Beta 1.95 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey folks, 

I went back over the content and fixed up a bunch of things that were bugs, both minor and major, in the game, as well as improved a bunch of audio. Hopefully, this edition is as clean as it gets but if there are bugs, as always, let me know & I'll sort them asap.

[b]So what's in this 1.95 edition today?[/b]

[list]
[*] 6,500 words of new story across three scenes with multiple versions, depending on which path you're on (Daisy, Lily, Rose, Harem, or Man About Town)
[*] 425 brand new images, with Daisy, Rose, Lily, and Lois making an appearance in this episode
[*] 39 new animations across three scenes, two of which are variations of a brand new scene, the other scene with Rose + MC is a remake of Rose cosplaying as a cheerleader, similar to the previous edition of the game, but hopefully with far, far better visuals, animations, and story in this version.
[*] Two new scenes in the replay gallery - you can pick which version of one of the new scenes you like, both variations with Daisy & MC, but slightly different depending on which option you select.
[*] 7 new audio files, 1 music track, and 6 sound effects
[*] Many audio bugs fixed, also lowered the volume of one of the most common walking sounds to make it less obnoxious (as pointed out by a few folks).
[*] Other bug fixing including on day2 afternoon, one branch had an incorrect Lily max love score, and then also a broken layout for the Lily Path Insights; a bug on day 4 that resulted in an adult scene that shouldn't have happened unless you were on the Daisy or Harem path (now appropriately, that scene is skipped if you're not on one of those two paths). Also edited the Elizabeth path and relationship on day 5 if you reject her, previously, these weren't set correctly if you decline her advances.
[*] My hard work for four solid weeks to bring you my best update yet.
[/list]

Next month, we'll see the last official update that's been planned for a while...of course, if there are requests, or other stuff I should be doing, let me know so I can add that to the list of possibilities.

By the end of this update, you should see text and indicators of what path you're on, and after my debugging session today, I think those are all sensible & much, much better than the original version of the game.

Have fun, and thanks for your interest in my work, it means a ton.

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.90 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there,

Back again with another update, and we're getting closer to the end of the brand new content for the remake.

[b]What's in the 1.90 edition ?[/b]

[list]
[*] About 4,600 words of story - a shorter update, since I've been shipping probably too often recently.
[*] 280+ images starting with day 5 afternoon and finishing with a new scene with MC and Elizabeth at her office.
[*] 42 brand new animations in two different scenes, both added to the replay gallery (1 with Daisy, Lily, and MC, and a new scene with MC and Elizabeth).
[*] 2 new sound effects.
[*] Changes to the beginning of the game, removing the older intro & instead starting at the bar with Lois.
[*] My hope that you enjoy the update.
[/list]

There are two more updates planned, one of those will have a lot more new content, the other will have a lot of content from the current complete game updated & improved for the various endings of the game. Hopefully this update doesn't include as many bugs as the last one - if there are any issues, I'll be happy to fix them as soon as possible as always.

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.85 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there,

I know, it's only been three weeks, but there's a lot of improvements I wanted to get into people's hands sooner than later stretching back to the earliest parts of the remake & up through the new content. 

[b]What's in the 1.85 edition ?[/b]

[list]
[*] About 6,000 words of story - it's only been like 3 weeks since the last update, so this fast turn around means I can't get as much done. However, the total word count in the remake is now at 102,841 - we're definitely on track to have a larger game than the original.
[*] 425 images starting with day 5 morning, and finishing up early afternoon, with multiple scenes remade.
[*] 28 brand new animations in two different scenes, both added to the replay gallery (1 with Lily, 1 with Daisy).
[*] 2 new sound effects.
[*] All new preferences for font size, border, font face, and more - my hope is you'll have a more usable, and accessible, experience than ever before.
[*] Tons of bug fixes from the beginning through the newest content.
[*] And, hopefully few if any new bugs :)
[/list]

Overall, I'm particularly happy with the new preferences page; while it could be prettier perhaps, the functionality is something I've never added to any prior game, and I'm excited about how much better the experience is when you can customize so many aspects of the text, font, and more.

There are only 3 more planned updates for the remake over the next few months so if you want anything in particular, feel free to holler. 

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.8 Remake Edition Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there, only a few more updates left until we're finished with the remake!

When I began the journey, I expected to finish in November, a few months ago, and here it is January, with three more updates across the next three months to go. I can't thank you enough for your support & encouragement as we make the game far, far better than ever before.

[b]What's in the 1.8 version?[/b]
[list]
[*] 517 new images (of those 90 are from the previous production edition, the remaining 427 are brand new)
[*] 47 new animations across two sexy scenes (also one sexy scene from the previous edition with 11 animations); the animations have been updated to match the image processing which included defect removal & color correction to better fit the new experience.
[*] 11,400 plus words of story, including the remainder of the fourth in game day.
[*] Brand new Love score out of X on the characters page, so it's easy to see what the total potential love score is versus how many points you've acquired with any of the characters in game so far.
[*] 6 new sound effects & music files
[*] Updated the Replay link to be in the left nav even before you start the game for easier access, and added the four new scenes to replay (one scene has two variations, depending on your past choices with Daisy in game, which leads to two different sets of animation).
[*] A new driving animation earlier in the game where MC visits Elizabeth & Tricia at the office on Day 2, and a similar driving animation when he visits the bookstore in this update.
[*] Tons of updates to the prior content based on Discord feedback including choice updates, menu updates & more.
[/list]
I hope your new year is also off to a great start and this makes it even better.

If there are any bugs, spelling, or other issues, please share, and I'm more than happy to fix anything that's not awesome.

Thank you for playing, 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.7 Remake Edition Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there, happy holidays from Big Chungus Productions!

This last month has been filled with holiday cheer, good food, and even better game updates (at least, we hope you think so) :) Today, I bring you the latest effort in the Her Heart's Desire remake - version 1.7, our largest one yet.

[b]What's in this edition?[/b]
[list]
[*] Fourteen thousand words of new story
[*] 568 new full HD images, and 47 animations across three new adult scenes
[*] 19 new music & audio effects files
[*] Added the scene replay feature, accessible via the left menu, or the "Stats," link in the upper left of the screen.
[*] My hopes and dreams that you all love the latest, and the remake overall, more than the original. [/list]
I hope you've had a wonderful holiday and that this update makes your new year just a little brighter.

If there are any bugs, spelling, or other issues, please share, and I'm more than happy to fix anything that's not awesome.

Thank you for playing, 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.6 Remake Edition Now Live
notes.content:
Hey there, it's a brand new beta today!

As usual, I've been working hard for the past month (ahem) writing, editing, and improving all the things to continue the remake of Her Heart's Desire. This edition is a little different in that there are no new animated scenes - but there will be next time, and even more as we get closer & closer to wrapping up the remake, and there were four animations early in the game that have been remade for this update with higher quality images and movement.

[b]What's in this edition?[/b]
[list]
[*] Nine thousand words of new story
[*] 416 new images, as well as four remade animations from the first animated scene in the game
[*] Brand new menu (similar to the prior production version)
[*] Revamped characters page, accessible via the new Stats link in the upper left, in addition to redone character images for that section versus the previous edition of the game.
[*] Renaming feature / change the customization in game via the character profile pages for Daisy, Lily, or Rose.
[/list]

The previous version of the game never had a persistent menu that linked to the characters page, which should help folks figure out where you stand with the various love interests in the game. 

If there are any bugs, spelling, or other issues, please share, and I'm more than happy to fix anything that's not awesome.

Thank you for playing, 

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Beta 1.5 Remake Updated
notes.content:
Hey there, we're back!

The latest edition of the Her Heart's Desire remake, 1.5, launches today after a month of hard work writing, rendering, and animating. So what's in the update?

[list]
[*] 7,400 words of new story
[*] 320 new images
[*] 29 new animations across two brand new sexy scenes
[*] 37 new music files and sound effects
[*] Scoring changes from the earlier game scenes based on some feedback in Discord
[*] Introducing two new never before seen characters in any version of the game, and Sara the coffee shop barista in a second job is introduced for the first time in the remake.
[*] Steam Deck compatibility? Maybe? I've also updated the code to see if we can make sure the Steam Keyboard shows up on the Deck which prevented the game from being functional, as well as updated the fonts used in the menu at the bottom of the screen.
[/list]

Hopefully the Deck updates are working properly, I don't have a device to test things out myself, so please chime in on how things pan out for you if you can.

Also as always, if you see anything that could be improved, or seems like a bug, feel free to shout & I'll fix it as soon as I can.

Stay Thirsty, 
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Beta 1.4 Available Today
notes.content:
Hey folks, we made it to Friday, it's the beginning of the weekend, and what better time to enjoy an awesome game update than the beginning of your time off from work - well, if you have a similar schedule as me, naturally. 

It's been a lot of time sitting in an uncomfortable chair, since my cat stole my good one, so I'm hopeful that despite the struggle, the update is as awesome or better than usual. 

[b]Here's the scoop:[/b]

[list]
[*] Story continues with the 2nd day in the game and over twelve thousand words in this update
[*] 417 new images including Daisy, Rose, Lily, and a new character (to the beta) in her second job
[*] Multiple new locations that were never featured in the original game
[*] 39 new sound effects & music tracks, bringing the total to 310+ audio files (far more than the previous production game)
[*] 15 brand new animations
[*] Lots of new transitions (good, bad, or meh? You tell me) in both the earlier parts o the beta and the newest content.
[*] Audio, image, and other bug fixes from the beginning of the beta through to the newest content, with a few dozen edits overall.
[/list]

As usual, bug reports of all kinds are appreciated, or if things are somehow perfection, whelp, I'll take compliments, too.

Stay Thirsty, 
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: New English Language Beta 1.3 Now Available
notes.content:
Happy Friday!

Due to some conflicting dates on my calendar, I'm shipping the beta 1.3 earlier than planned this month, but rest assured, for less than three weeks, it's got a lot more content than I used to create in two months. 

So what's new?

[list]
[*] Six thousand words of new story, bringing the total to about 41 thousand, six hundred words - we're now over a third of the way done, and some portions in the later updates should be faster as they'll have less rework, I think.
[*] 297 new images (some are remakes from the current production edition, some are brand new).
[*] 14 brand new animations (13 of those are a remake of the previous Jen + MC scene in the bathroom) one is a surprise as part of a scene that was not in the current edition
[*] 31 new music and sound effects files, which brings the total to 276 - finally, more audio than anything else I've ever done. I'm particularly proud of this one.
[*] At least one spelling and grammar fix from the previous 1.2, and hopefully less bugs than last time ;)
[*] Updated August 17th with multiple spelling, grammar, and at least one code fix which had the wrong text depending on the scene with Lisa in the shop.
[*] Updated August 18th with two fixes for dialogue in the shop scene - one to undo the bug I created yesterday, and one to hopefully fix the original issue. 

[/list]


I'll be back next month with the next beta remake update. Feedback, comments, suggestions, and recommendations always appreciated.

Cheers,
Brosef

notes.title: Beta 1.2 Now Available
notes.content:
Hey fam, thanks for tuning in to Big Chungus Productions. We've got another hot one for you, and if I do say so myself, the newest Her Heart's Desire beta is my best work yet.

[b]So what's new?
[/b]
[list]
[*] 550 new images (all new, nothing re-used from the current production game), and combined with the previous beta, there now 1,449 images in the remake. That's more a lot more than thirty percent of the current completed game.

[*] 19 new animations, these include a remake of a scene in the current game, as well as a new goodbye kiss that's one of my longest animations so far (almost 8 seconds), and a brand new scene as voted on by supporters in a recent poll.

[*] 83 new sound effect & music files - the total for this remake is now at 245, which is just shy of what's in Milfy Cases. I think you'll enjoy the audio even more than usual this time around - or not, but I'm optimistic.

[*] All new 11,400 words of story, some of which is a rewrite of the current game, and some for new scenes was written from scratch. The total in the remake is now just over 33,400 words, which is only ~6K words short of the latest Milfy Cases update before I paused development on that title to remake HHD.

[*] Revamped office scene with Elizabeth, Tricia, and Eric - I've used a few new techniques, some new Renpy transitions, and more to make something that I consider some of my best work yet.
[/list]

Excited? I'll bet, me too! It's already available, just download the beta here on Steam.

notes.title: English Language Beta Test for New Version
notes.content:
Howdy!

Today, I've got something special for you, the first edition of the remake for Her Heart's Desire. Before I go and finish everything, I wanted to share the initial first episode as a beta (English only, for now) and collect feedback.

[b]What's in the remake Her Heart's Desire 1.1 edition?[/b]

[list]
[*] 700+ new images, and just shy of 900 images in total.
[*] 9 new animations, which are a remake of the first animated scene in game
[*] 94 new audio files including new sound effects & music tracks

If you have time and are so inclined, I'd love to get your take on this newly revamped experience. What's good? Could be better? Anything missing? That sort of thing.

Thanks a ton,
Brosef

notes.title: New Opacity Slider Feature
notes.content:
Hi all-

Thanks for your interest in Her Heart's Desire! By special request, I've added a new feature to the preferences page to enable players to change the opacity in the image for the text in the game. This way, instead of having low contrast on some scenes, you get to choose how dark, or transparent, the background image is while playing.

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Video conversions, two spelling errors, and a sound effect change

Hey all, this is the holiday "let's make it even more awesome," update. There isn't much for spelling (only two minor issues I found) and there was the heartbeat sound that I've swapped out for a premium asset which is far better.

Last but not least, it's almost 3 gigabytes lighter since now nearly all the image frame animation has been swapped out for video animations in webm. This ensures playback is buttery smooth in all the scenes, and makes the overall gameplay infinitely better. 

Happy Holidays from Big Chungus Productions (that's me), Brosef Chungus.
Cheers.

notes.title: Harem Ever After Content Expansion & Update
notes.content:
[h2]What's special in the Harem Ever After update?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rewritten introduction, multiple other scenes as well, for clarity and quality. Every scene file was at least partially rewritten in this update to ensure the main character is always the narrator which reduces the potential confusion.
[*] Three new fully animated scenes, with more than 26 animations, some with 30, 40, or even 60 frames - yeah, I tried to push things & improve in that area too.
[*] Twenty plus new renders in my latest visual style, a significant upgrade to the previous styling in the game.
[*] 43 scenes in the replay feature, now when replaying a scene you can experience every scene the same way as it happened in the game.
[*] Compressed animations to shrink the game footprint from 7.7 gigabytes to just over 5 gigs; this includes the new content as well. 
[*] Added character label & italics to all the lines where the main character was thinking, but it didn't have a label.
[*] Reworked sounds, the man laughing in particular, as well as others that didn't have the same high quality as the remainder. 
[*] Customization has been simplified, enabling people who don't want to customize all the text to skip many questions in the game & focus on the story.
[/list]

notes.title: Coming soon from Big Chungus Productions - Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress
notes.content:
Coming soon from Big Chungus Productions, the next epic adult visual novel, Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress.

[b]Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress main plot:[/b]
A recent college graduate, Chad (name customizable) landed a sweet job chronicling the local ecology next to a modern cabin on the lake. Then one stormy night, a fateful meeting changed everything. When Chad awoke, he was laying in a field, not far from his Landlady's house. Meeting with her is a local detective, investigating the tragedy that not only destroyed MC's rental, but everything he owned. Luckily, the attractive detective Jenny isn't pursing Chad as a suspect, and even better, Mary (name customizable) graciously allows MC to continue his rental agreement by taking a spare bedroom in her house.

That morning, he meets shy, bookish Alice (name customizable) his new younger roommate, and standoffish Sally, his new, slightly older roommate. With their help, can Chad get back on his feet, and discover why his house was blown up? Or will the mysterious assailant try again, and bring an untimely end to the hero before his journey concludes? Find out in his exciting adventure with romance, mystery, suspense, and mild elements of horror.

Learn more on the store page, view the trailer, and wishlist Milfy Cases today!

notes.title: Her Heart's Desire Bonus Edition
notes.content:
Her Heart's Desire Bonus Edition launches soon with a massive increase in content for you to enjoy. There are multiple love interests that previously weren't a part of an animated scene with the main character, this update fixes that, and so much more.

[list]
[*] There is a new scene with Chef Naomi and Rose, while the other characters watch. If the MC chooses, he can skip going back home with the other tenants and have a lot of fun with Naomi & Rose. 20 new images and over 20 animations.
[*] Lois the bartender never got any love with the MC either; in this edition, in the bonus scene you can skip going back home after the date with Elizabeth, and keep flirting. 33 new images, and 14 animations.
Vanessa and Sara, the two baristas in the coffee shop, kissed in front of the MC in the previous edition, but now, there's a whole new threesome scene with them. 25 new images, and 17 new animations.
[*] The harem ending with Dee, Lily, and Rose has been updated & expanded with 3 new images, and 9 new animations.
[*] For the new scenes, I had to mix new audio, so there are now 7 additional sound effects to accompany the new scenes above.
[*] Revamped the left menu, replacing the Replay & Gallery links with a single link that points to a combined page for Replay or Bonus content; this way, it's easier to navigate to your favorite characters to see their bonus content - or in the case of the three tenants, the slide shows that seem hard for some people to find. 
[*] Tricia library scene with MC has multiple improved animations which were made by combining existing loops where the start frame was the same; it's improved compared to before, and plays much, much better.
[*] Lily & MC hotel scene near the end on day 6 also had improvements in multiple animations, resulting in longer, more interesting, and smoother movement. This was the same technique as the expansion & upgrade to the animations with Tricia in the library scene.
[*] Other miscellaneous two frame and other animation fixes in multiple places in the game.
[*] Last but not least, more story, with an additional five thousand words in the various new scenes.
[/list]

The three new animated scenes are inside the revamped Replay / Gallery page, which is now included in a single link in the main game menu instead of having the two links for both replay & gallery. From there, you can select either one. Note that the Bonus Edition animated scenes with Chef Naomi & Rose, Lois, and the baristas are only accessible in the gallery feature, they are not part of the replay feature, as those scenes are only for the canonical game content. The Bonus Edition scenes are an alternate timeline, rather than new updates to the existing story.
